name: App update: Boost V2, Boost lap

enter.note: He walks in from the dialog's left edge with the phone, lifts it as its arrow fills, and the update upgrades him. Plays once when the dialog opens.

loopA.note: Upgraded, calm: the loop that plays while the dialog waits for a choice.

loopB.note: The other upgraded loop; the pool "loop" plays one of the two, never the same one twice in a row.

now.note: After Yes, Update Now: the payoff, under a second. The store opens at once; this plays over it and never holds it up.

later.note: After Maybe later: a calm goodbye with one small wave, then he rests.

semantics.label: Fabio in a space helmet and a jetpack
